page.overview:
What is Bucklebury?

Bucklebury was the chief village of Buckland. It was located on the slopes of Buck Hill behind Brandy Hall, and on the east bank of the Brandywine River. Bucklebury Ferry served as a means of crossing the river to and from the Marish.
